name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, both campaigns spent $219.50 total across 11,850 impressions and 150 clicks, bringing in 5 leads at $43.90 each.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads of the day on $153.40 spend, 8,800 impressions, 120 clicks, a 1.4% click rate, and a cost per lead of $30.68.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Month-to-date Meta spend for 2026-11 sits at $487.00 with 28 days still remaining.
The mature 2026-09-21 cohort shows 38 leads, with 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).
The mature 2026-09-28 cohort shows 40 leads, with 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and no hires yet — but it is too young to judge its rates.
